name: Murghab oasis
summary: An inland branching fan: a cultivated channel corridor, river-associated thickets, dry branches and open steppe. No sea, palace plan or continuous desert forest.

features.label: Vegetation & cultivation
features.text: Anau shows streamside tugai/tugay, particularly tamarisk, fields and neighboring steppe. These early findings do not supply later forest cover for all Turkmenistan. Report pages 6.

features.label: Water & landform
features.text: An inland alluvial fan: some Bronze Age channels were relatively stable while others were unreliable. Togolok and Ojakly communities adapted differently to local water access. Report pages 6.

features.label: What is not reconstructed
features.text: No complete 3500–300 BCE fan-wide channel map. The scene uses schematic branching, not measured historical stream centerlines. No species inventory is supplied for this scene; no animated wildlife or livestock has been added. Report pages 6.
